name: Fretting
overview: The Bible warns believers against fretting, particularly over the success of evildoers or the presence of wickedness, urging trust and patient waiting on the Lord instead. Psalms 37 exhorts us not to envy or be anxious about those who prosper through wicked means, while Proverbs highlights that a heart that frets against the Lord reflects foolishness. Romans 8:28 reassures that God works all things for good to those who love Him, providing a foundation for peace amid trials. Even Leviticus uses the term 'fretting' to describe a spreading leprosy, symbolizing how anxiety can contaminate the soul, underscoring the call to rest in God's sovereign care.
